kimetsu.configuration.title: Kimetsu Settings
kimetsu.configuration.assist_level.toolt: PvE only. 1 shows the metronome ring and the impact notch; 2 also widens the timing windows; 3 also keeps the Rhythm for you, for less damage. The server may cap it.
kimetsu.configuration.guard_mode.tooltip: Hold: the guard is up while the key is held. Toggle: each tap is a guard press, and the guard stays up until your next attack, Pommel Strike, Step or Breathe, or a double-tap.
How strongly lock-on turns the camera toward its target, in percent. 0 keeps the lock without turning the camera.
kimetsu.configuration.debug_overlay.tool: Whether the combat debug overlay is on when you join a world. Its key still toggles it.
kimetsu.configuration.calibration.toolti: Timing calibration for your audio and display latency.
kimetsu.configuration.calibration.audio_: How late you hear the game.
kimetsu.configuration.calibration.visual: How late you see the game.
kimetsu.configuration.fight_logging.tool: Keep fight logs in kimetsu/fights/, one file a day and dimension. /kimetsu debug log overrides it until this changes or the server restarts.
kimetsu.configuration.assist.tooltip: PvE Rhythm assist: the metronome, wider windows, Auto-Rhythm.
kimetsu.configuration.assist.allowed.too: Whether players may use Rhythm assist at all.
kimetsu.configuration.assist.max_level.t: The highest assist level a player may use.
kimetsu.configuration.input.tooltip: Rate limits on each client's input, metered by its own stamps. Each is at least its default, which an honest client never reaches. A player gets them as they log in.
Input frames that may come at once.
Presses and releases that may come at once.
Messages a second past which a second counts toward a flood.
kimetsu.configuration.input.flood_second: How many such seconds in a row make a flood.
Whether a flood disconnects the client. Off, it is only logged and shown by /kimetsu debug; the limits still merge what is over them.
